title: Greet and introduce yourself
bridge: Faransiis, inoo dhexeeyaannu leennahay 'Hola' ama 'Buenos días', oo inoo dhexeeyaannu u muuqnaynnaannu leennahay 'Me llamo...' ama 'Soy...'. Ingiriisi, waxay u eg yahay: aannu isticmaalno 'Hello' ama 'Good morning' oo aannu leennahay 'My name is...' ama 'I am...'. Farqada ugu muhiima ah ayaa in Ingiriisi ma aannu leennin 'I am called...' (hadana waxay u eg yahay saxiixso, laakiin waxay ku qallafsan tahay si fiican oo aan u eg yahay tababarka maanta). Xusuuso in Ingiriisi, aannu isticmaalno fiilka 'to be' inaannu weyddiisto magaca: 'What is your name?' (ma 'How are you called?').
rule: Inoo dhexeeya: 'Hello' (Hola), 'Hi' (si aan u eg yahay), 'Good morning' (Buenos días), 'Good afternoon' (Buenas tardes), 'Good evening' (Buenas noches). Inoo muuqnayn: 'My name is...' (Me llamo...) ama 'I am...' (Soy...). Weyddiisto magaca: 'What is your name?' (¿Cómo te llamas?). Jawaabo inoo dhexeeya: 'Nice to meet you' (Encantado/a de conocerte) oo jawaabta waxay noqon tahay 'Nice to meet you too'. Tago: 'Goodbye', 'Bye', 'See you later'.

common_error.explanation: Faransiis, aannu leennahay 'Me llamo Anna', laakiin Ingiriisi, habka ugu caansan inoo muuqnaynta waxay noqon tahay 'My name is...' ama 'I am...'. 'I am called' waxay u eg yahay, laakiin waxay ku qallafsan tahay si fiican oo aan u eg yahay tababarka maanta.

examples.note: Inoo dhexeeya caadiga ah.
Habka caadiga ah inaad sheegtid magacaaga.
Su'aalka tooska ah inaad ogaato magaca.
Tago aan u eg yahay.

title: Give personal information (age, nationality, profession)
bridge: Faransiis, inoo sheegtaa da'da, waxaynu leedahay 'J'ai 25 ans' (verbiga 'avoir' ayanu isticmaalo), laakiin Ingiriisi waxay leedahay 'I am 25 years old' (verbiga 'to be' ayanu isticmaalo). Qoyska, Faransiis waxaynu leedahay 'Je suis français/française' (adiga aan la isticmaalin), laakiin Ingiriisi waxaynu leedahay 'I am French' (adiga aan la isticmaalin). Shaqo, Faransiis waxaynu leedahay 'Je suis professeur/professeure' (adiga aan la isticmaalin), laakiin Ingiriisi waxaynu u baahan doonnaa adiga: 'I am a teacher'.
rule: Da'da: 'I am [tiro] years old' (misaal: I am 25 years old). Qoyska: 'I am [qoyska]' (misaal: I am French, I am Mexican). Shaqo: 'I am a/an [shaqo]' (misaal: I am a doctor, I am an engineer). Su'aasha: 'How old are you?' (Maxay da'daad?), 'Where are you from?' (Xaggee baad ka yimid?), 'What do you do?' (Maxaa shaqaalahaaga?) ama 'What is your job?'.

common_error.explanation: Faransiis waxaynu leedahay 'J'ai 25 ans' verbiga 'avoir' ayanu isticmaalo, laakiin Ingiriisi waxay isticmaalaa verbiga 'to be' da'da. Waxaa loo yaqaan inay mid yihiin khaladaha ugu badan ee ku tashan Faransiiska.

examples.note: Verbiga 'to be' ayanu isticmaalo da'da.
Adiga aan la isticmaalin qoyska.
Adiga 'a' ama 'an' ayanu isticmaalo shaqo.
Su'aal xaggee baad ka yimid.

title: Describe objects and people (basic)
bridge: Farangaas, inoo dhisoo su’aal iyo dadka waxaan ku qoray cadaan cadaan: 'un coche rojo', 'una chica alta'. Ingiriisi, cadaanka wuxuu yimid HORMARKA su’aalka: 'a red car', 'a tall girl'. Waxaana naga istaagay fiilka 'to be' inaanu u sheego su’aalaha guud (She is tall) iyo 'have got' inaanu u sheego sifaadka jidhan (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Inoo dhisoo: 1) Adjective + noun (a big house). 2) Subject + verb 'to be' + adjective (The house is big). 3) Subject + 'have/has got' + characteristic (She has got long hair). Adjectives common: big (weyn), small (yar), tall (weyn), short (yar), beautiful (qurux), old (dhow), young (dhalinyar), fast (degdeg ah), slow (dhow).

common_error.explanation: Farangaas, cadaanka wuxuu yimid daraaddo su’aalka ('un coche rojo'), laakiin Ingiriisi cadaanka wuxuu yimid HORMARKA su’aalka ('a red car'). Waxaana mid ka mid ah khaladaha ugu badan ee ku dhacdo kuwa af-Soomaaliga.

examples.note: Cadaanka wuxuu yimid horumar ka hor su’aalka.
Waxaan isticmaamay 'to be' inaanu u sheego su’aalaha guud.
Waxaan isticmaamay 'have got' inaanu u sheego sifaadka jidhan.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.translation: Walaashay waa dhalinyar iyo wuxuu lahaa indhaha jeesjees.
examples.note: Tarta 'to be' iyo 'have got'.

title: Talk about daily routines
bridge: Faransiis, inoo ka hadlaya rutinka maalin walba waxaynu isticmaalaa ciyaarta saddexan (présent): 'Je me lève à 7 heures, je prends mon petit déjeuner et je vais au travail'. Ingiriishi, waxaynu isticmaalaa ciyaarta saddexan (present simple) sidii ay tahay: 'I get up at 7, have breakfast and go to work'. Tifaacadda ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay in Ingiriishi waxaynu isticmaalaa qalabka 'at' waqtiga ('at 7 o'clock'), 'in' qaybta maalinta ('in the morning') iyo 'on' maalmo ('on Monday'). Waxaynu isticmaalaa naasaha midaabaan oo kale sida 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes' ilaa ugu horreeya fiilka ugu muhiimsan.
rule: Rutinka hadalka: 1) Isticmaali ciyaarta saddexan (I get up, she works). 2) Isticmaali xuruumaha waqtiga: 'at' + waqtiga (at 8 am), 'in' + qaybta maalinta (in the morning), 'on' + maalinta (on Friday). 3) Isticmaali naasaha midaabaan ilaa ugu horreeya fiilka (I always eat breakfast). 4) Su'aalaadka: 'What time do you get up?' ama 'When do you have lunch?'.

concept_examples.text: She usually has breakfast at 8 am.
concept_examples.translation: Iyadaa adag ah ayay ugu dhaqmayso subaxda 8 subaxda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈjuːʒuəli hæz ˈbrekfəst æt eɪt æm/

concept_examples.text: We go to work at 9 in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɡəʊ tə wɜːk æt naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: What time do you have dinner?

common_error.wrong: I am eating breakfast every morning.
common_error.explanation: Faransiiska, mararka qaarkood waxaynu isticmaalaa ciyaarta dabeecad ah (présent continu) waxyaalihii adag ah ('Je suis en train de déjeuner chaque matin'), laakiin Ingiriishi, rutinka iyo xiisooyinka, waxaynu isticmaalaa ciyaarta saddexan, ma aha ciyaarta dabeecad ah.

examples.note: Fiilka ciyaarta saddexan oo rutinka ah.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lʌntʃ æt wʌn piː em/
examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalaa 'at' waqtiga xadidan.
Naasaha midaabaan ilaa ugu horreeya fiilka ugu muhiimsan.

examples.original: What time do you go to bed?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt taɪm duː juː ɡəʊ tə bed/
examples.note: Su'aasha 'what time' + do/does.

title: Express likes and dislikes (I like / Aan u jeclahay)
bridge: Farcee, inoo jeclahay waxaan u isticmaamo fiilka 'jeclahay': 'Waxaan jeclahay pizza' (literally 'Pizza baa i jeclahay'). Ingiriisi, waxaan isticmaamo fiilka 'like' qalabka isku halleeyay + like + object: 'I like pizza'. Tifaacadda ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay farcee fiilka 'jeclahay' wuxuu la wada hadlayaa object-ka (waxaan jeclahay pizza, waxaan jeclahay pizzas), ingiriisi 'like' wuxuu la wada hadlayaa isku halleeyay (I like pizza, He likes pizza). Hadana xusuuso inaad u jeeddo jeeddo adag oo aad tidhaahdo 'I don't like' (ma jeclahay).
rule: Inoo jeclahay: 1) Aad u jeeddo: I/you/we/they like + object (I like coffee). He/she/it likes + object (She likes coffee). 2) Aan u jeeddo: I/you/we/they don't like (I don't like tea). He/she/it doesn't like (He doesn't like tea). 3) Su'aalo: Do you like...? (Maxay jeclahay...?), Does she like...? (Maxay jeclahay...?). 4) Inoo jeeddo adag: 'I like it very much' (Waxaan jeclahay adag) ama 'I really like it' (Waxaan jeclahay adag).

common_error.explanation: Farcee, adverbu 'mucho' wuxuu yimaa fiilka dambe: 'Waxaan jeclahay adag pizza'. Ingiriisi, adverbu 'very much' wuxuu yimaa jimilka ama object-ka dambe: 'I like pizza very much'. Inoo celcelis fiilka iyo object-ka waa khalad aan la oggolaeynayo.

examples.note: Fiilka 'like' qalabka asasiga.
Waxaan ku darnaa -s saddexad ee dadka.
Waxaan isticmaamo 'doesn't' + fiilka asasiga.
Su'aalo 'do' + isku halleeyay + fiilka asasiga.

title: Ask for and give prices
bridge: Faransiis, ina soo galin qiimaha waxaynu leedahay '¿Cuánto cuesta?' ama '¿Cuánto es?'. Ingiriisi, waxaynu leedahay 'How much is it?' (singular) ama 'How much are they?' (plural). Kala duwan, waxaynu isticmaalaynaa 'How much does it cost?' (¿Cuánto cuesta?). Kala duwana ugu muhiimka ah waxay tahay in Ingiriisi, waxaynu isticmaalaynaa fiilka 'to be' ama fiilka 'cost' la jira auxiliary 'does' si aan u waydiiyo.
rule: Si ay u soo galin qiimaha: 1) 'How much is it?' (oo ah shay) ama 'How much are they?' (oo ah qiyaastii). 2) 'How much does it cost?' (¿Cuánto cuesta?). 3) 'How much is the T-shirt?' (¿Cuánto cuesta la camiseta?). Si ay u jawaabin: 'It is 25 dollars' ama 'It costs 25 dollars'. Su'aalooyinka, waxaynu daima isticmaalaynaa fiilka 'to be' ama auxiliary 'does' + 'cost'.

common_error.explanation: Faransiis, waxaynu leedahay '¿Cuánto cuesta?' ila auxiliary. Ingiriisi, fiilka 'cost' isticmaalaya, waxaynu u baahanahay auxiliary 'does' si aan u waydiiyo. Tani waa khalad aan u adag tahay ee ku nool bahalkii Faransiiska ee u turjumaya erayada si adag.

examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalaynaa 'to be' si aan u waydiiyo qiimaha.

examples.original: How much does the bag cost?
examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalaynaa 'does' + 'cost' si aan u waydiiyo.
Waxaynu isticmaalaynaa 'costs' oo ah third person singular.
Waxaynu isticmaalaynaa 'are' oo ah plural.

title: Sheeg meeshadii qaybooyinka
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, inoo sheegay meesha qayb ahaan waxaynu leedahay 'Wuxuu ku jira shida...', 'Wuxuu ka dhowrsan bankiga', 'Wuxuu dhowrsan steshini'. Ingiriisi, waxaannu isticmaalanna preposition-ka meeshadaha 'on', 'in', 'at', 'next to', 'near', 'opposite', 'behind', 'in front of'. Wareega ah ee ku salaysan af-Soomaaliga waxay tahay in 'ee' waxaannu isticmaalanna qayb badan, Ingiriisi, preposition-ka waxay ku talin taasoo ku salaysan siyaasadda. Xusuuso in meesha aad u isticmaashid fiil-ka 'to be' (It is...).
rule: Inoo sheegay meesha: 1) Isticmaali fiil-ka 'to be' (The bank is...). 2) Preposition-ka meeshadaha: 'on' (ee, ku salaysan suurad ama shida), 'in' (dhexdooda meesha), 'at' (ee meesha la mid ah), 'next to' (ka dhowrsan), 'near' (dhowrsan), 'opposite' (horay), 'behind' (dhinaca), 'in front of' (horay). 3) Inoo waydii: 'Where is the...?' (Meeku jira...?) ama 'Is there a... near here?' (Meeshaas ku jira... dhowrsan?).

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is near the park.
The school is next to the church.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/

concept_examples.text: The pharmacy is on Main Street.
concept_examples.translation: Dukanka dawasheeda wuxuu ku jira shida ee ee ee.

common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxaynu leedahay 'Wuxuu ku jira moolanka' si kastaba ha ahaadee aad u dhaqso shaxsiga. Ingiriisi, shaxsiga 'It' ama 'He/She' waa la doonayaa. Si kastaba ha ahaadee, 'ee moolanka' waxay leedahay 'on the corner' (maahee 'in the corner') markii meesha aad u jirto moolanka shidadaha.

examples.original: The cat is in the garden.
examples.note: Waxaannu isticmaalanna 'in' ee ku salaysan meeshadaha la xiriiray.

examples.original: The restaurant is next to the hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈrestrɒnt ɪz nekst tə ðə həʊˈtel/
examples.note: Waxaannu isticmaalanna 'next to' ee ku salaysan dhowrsan dhinaca.

examples.original: The bank is opposite the park.
examples.note: Waxaannu isticmaalanna 'opposite' ee ku salaysan horay.
Su'aal dhaqan ah 'Where'.
